chunks: Ayyub ibn Nuh narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
One should move away from the main roads to the right or to the left and pray.

key_terms.يَتَنَحَّى: to move aside or keep away

ai.seo_question: Where should one pray if one is near a main road?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction concerning the place of salat (prayer). It directs a person to move away from the main roadway, either to the right or the left, before praying.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.735 - It was narrated from Imam (as) said, by Ayyub ibn Nuh that He said:
"One should move away from the main roads to the right or to the left and pray."
